title: Terms of use
meta_description: The terms for using artificiaai.com and for enquiring about Artificia AI's masterclass, corporate AI training and services. Short and in plain words.

fields.body:
These terms cover your use of artificiaai.com, which is run by Artificia Intellec Pvt Ltd ("Artificia", "we"). By using the site, you agree to them.

The information on this site

We keep this site accurate and up to date, but courses, timings and services can change. Please confirm the details with us before you decide.

An enquiry is not a booking

Sending a form is an enquiry. A course place, a training program or a project starts only when we both confirm it in writing.

Fees

We share fees and payment terms with you directly, before you enrol or sign. Any refund terms are set out in that confirmation.

Outcomes

Figures on this site marked as typical outcomes describe AI-enabled teams in general. They are not results we promise for you.

What you gain from a course depends on how you use it. We do not promise a job or an income.

Content and names

The text, images and design of this site belong to Artificia or are used with permission. Please ask before you copy them.

Client names, such as Orkay Tiles International, appear with the client's permission.

Other websites

We link to other sites, such as WhatsApp, Google Maps and Google Drive. We are not responsible for their content or policies.

Your data

Our privacy policy explains how we handle the details you send us.

Law

These terms follow the laws of India. The courts of Vadodara, Gujarat, have jurisdiction.
